title: Create a 30-second, 15-cut video with a DV 16mm tape camcorder aesthetic…
content:
Create a 30-second, 15-cut video with a DV 16mm tape camcorder aesthetic. Handheld POV alternates between CHASE and her workout partner, with occasional shots from a camera propped on a bench/rack. Imperfect framing, hand shake, delayed focus, clumsy zooms, slight blur, tape noise, warm bloomed highlights, flickering auto-exposure, muted contrast, realistic skin tones. The camcorder itself is never visible.

Characters: CHASE is a Korean woman in her 20s with a high black ponytail, expressive eyes, flushed cheeks, slim athletic build, wearing a modest long-sleeve athletic top, joggers/leggings, and sneakers. Her hair becomes visibly damp with sweat. PARTNER is a Korean woman in her 20s with tied-back hair and a similar athletic build, wearing modest long-sleeve workout clothes and sneakers. Use the attached reference images for both.

Setting: Hot summer-evening gym with broken AC. A stationary fan blows warm air, a door is propped open, and the lighting feels unusually warm and harsh. Weight rack, mats, mirrors, benches, and water bottles visible.

Action: They enter fanning themselves and joke about the heat. They set up at the weight rack, take turns lifting and spotting, encouraging each other. Close-up of sweaty hands gripping the bar. They catch their breath, laugh about already being soaked, then walk to the mats for a mandatory water break. They drink together, then compete in a plank, teasing each other about who will quit first. Sweat drips onto the mat as they struggle and laugh. Both collapse onto the mats simultaneously, laughing and breathless. They sit up, jokingly fan each other with a towel, then finish with an arm’s-length sweaty selfie and tired high-five.

Dialogue:
CHASE: “Okay, it is way too hot in here today.”
PARTNER: “The AC’s been out since this morning, I swear.”
CHASE: “Alright, let’s just push through it.”
CHASE: “You’ve got it, come on!”
PARTNER: “Okay, I’m already soaked.”
CHASE: “Water break, mandatory.”
PARTNER: “Okay, who’s giving up first?”
CHASE: “Not—me—”
PARTNER: “Okay, that’s officially a tie.”
CHASE: “This heat is actually insane though.”
CHASE, smiling into camera: “Okay, we survived — see you guys!”

Keep the tone playful, sweaty, energetic, competitive but supportive, with genuine exhaustion, laughter, heavy breathing, flushed faces, and increasingly visible sweat throughout.

es.content:
Crea un video de 30 segundos, con 15 cortes, con una estética de videocámara DV de cinta de 16 mm. La POV en mano alterna entre CHASE y su compañera de entrenamiento, con tomas ocasionales desde una cámara apoyada en un banco/soporte. Encuadre imperfecto, temblor de mano, enfoque tardío, zooms torpes, ligero desenfoque, ruido de cinta, luces cálidas y difusas, autoexposición parpadeante, contraste apagado, tonos de piel realistas. La videocámara en sí nunca es visible.

Personajes: CHASE es una mujer coreana de veintitantos años, con una coleta alta negra, ojos expresivos, mejillas sonrojadas, complexión atlética y delgada, vestida con una camiseta deportiva modesta de manga larga, joggers/leggings y zapatillas. Su cabello se vuelve visiblemente húmedo por el sudor. PARTNER es una mujer coreana de veintitantos años, con el cabello recogido y una complexión atlética similar, vestida con ropa deportiva modesta de manga larga y zapatillas. Usa las imágenes de referencia adjuntas para ambas.

Escenario: Gimnasio en una tarde-noche de verano, con el aire acondicionado averiado. Un ventilador fijo sopla aire caliente, una puerta está entornada, y la iluminación se siente inusualmente cálida y dura. Se ven un rack de pesas, colchonetas, espejos, bancos y botellas de agua.

Acción: Entran abanicándose y bromeando sobre el calor. Se colocan junto al rack de pesas, se turnan para levantar y hacer spotting, animándose mutuamente. Primer plano de manos sudorosas agarrando la barra. Recuperan el aliento, se ríen de que ya están empapadas, y luego van a las colchonetas para un descanso obligatorio para beber agua. Beben juntas, luego compiten en una plancha, burlándose de quién se rendirá primero. El sudor gotea sobre la colchoneta mientras luchan y se ríen. Ambas caen sobre las colchonetas al mismo tiempo, riendo y sin aliento. Se incorporan, se abanican juguetonamente con una toalla, y terminan con una selfie sudorosa a la distancia de un brazo y un high-five cansado.

Diálogo:
CHASE: “Okay, it is way too hot in here today.”
PARTNER: “The AC’s been out since this morning, I swear.”
CHASE: “Alright, let’s just push through it.”
CHASE: “You’ve got it, come on!”
PARTNER: “Okay, I’m already soaked.”
CHASE: “Water break, mandatory.”
PARTNER: “Okay, who’s giving up first?”
CHASE: “Not—me—”
PARTNER: “Okay, that’s officially a tie.”
CHASE: “This heat is actually insane though.”
CHASE, smiling into camera: “Okay, we survived — see you guys!”

Mantén un tono juguetón, sudoroso, enérgico, competitivo pero de apoyo, con cansancio genuino, risas, respiración agitada, rostros sonrojados y sudor cada vez más visible a lo largo de la escena.

fr.content:

La POV à main levée alterne entre CHASE et sa partenaire d’entraînement, avec quelques plans pris depuis une caméra posée sur un banc/une rack. Cadrage imparfait, tremblements de main, mise au point retardée, zooms maladroits, léger flou, bruit de bande, hautes lumières chaudes et diffuses, auto-exposition vacillante, contraste atténué, tons de peau réalistes. Le caméscope lui-même n’est jamais visible.

Personnages : CHASE est une femme coréenne d’une vingtaine d’années, avec une longue queue-de-cheval noire, des yeux expressifs, des joues rosies, une silhouette athlétique fine, portant un haut de sport modeste à manches longues, un jogging/legging et des sneakers. Ses cheveux deviennent visiblement humides de sueur. PARTNER est une femme coréenne d’une vingtaine d’années, avec les cheveux attachés et une silhouette athlétique similaire, portant des vêtements de sport modestes à manches longues et des sneakers. Utilisez les images de référence jointes pour les deux.

Décor : salle de sport en soirée d’été, très chaude, avec la climatisation en panne. Un ventilateur fixe souffle de l’air chaud, une porte est maintenue ouverte, et l’éclairage paraît anormalement chaud et dur. On voit un rack de poids, des tapis, des miroirs, des bancs et des bouteilles d’eau.

Action : Elles entrent en s’éventant et plaisantent sur la chaleur. Elles s’installent au rack de poids, se relaient pour soulever et parer, en s’encourageant mutuellement. Gros plan sur des mains moites agrippant la barre. Elles reprennent leur souffle, rient d’être déjà trempées, puis vont sur les tapis pour une pause hydratation obligatoire. Elles boivent ensemble, puis s’affrontent en gainage, se taquinant sur celle qui abandonnera en premier. La sueur goutte sur le tapis pendant qu’elles luttent et rient. Toutes deux s’effondrent simultanément sur les tapis, en riant et à bout de souffle. Elles se redressent, s’éventent mutuellement avec une serviette en plaisantant, puis terminent par un selfie moite à bout de bras et un high-five fatigué.

Gardez un ton enjoué, moite, énergique, compétitif mais solidaire, avec une vraie fatigue, des rires, une respiration lourde, des visages rougis et une sueur de plus en plus visible tout au long de la scène.

ja.content:
30秒、15カットの動画を、DV 16mmテープカムコーダーの美学で作成する。ハンドヘルドのPOVはCHASEと彼女のワークアウト仲間の間で切り替わり、時折、ベンチやラックに置いたカメラからのショットも入る。不完全なフレーミング、手ブレ、遅れたフォーカス、不器用なズーム、わずかなブレ、テープノイズ、暖かくブルームしたハイライト、ちらつくオート露出、抑えめのコントラスト、自然な肌色。カムコーダー本体は決して映さない。

Characters: CHASE is a Korean woman in her 20s with a high black ponytail, expressive eyes, flushed cheeks, slim athletic build, wearing a modest long-sleeve athletic top, joggers/leggings, and sneakers. Her hair becomes visibly damp with sweat. PARTNER is a Korean woman in her 20s with tied-back hair and a similar athletic build, wearing modest long-sleeve workout clothes and sneakers. Use the attached reference images for both.

Setting: 壊れたACのある真夏の夕方のジム。据え置きファンがぬるい風を送り、ドアは開け放たれ、照明はいつも以上に暖かく、強く感じられる。ウェイトラック、マット、鏡、ベンチ、水筒が見える。

Action: 2人は暑さにあおぎながら入ってきて、冗談を言い合う。ウェイトラックで準備をし、交互に持ち上げては補助し合い、励まし合う。バーを握る汗ばんだ手のクローズアップ。息を整え、もうびしょ濡れだと笑い合い、その後マットへ向かって必須の水分補給タイムを取る。2人で水を飲み、次にプランクで勝負し、どちらが先に諦めるかをからかい合う。苦戦しながら笑い、汗がマットに滴る。最後は2人同時にマットへ倒れ込み、笑いながら息を切らす。起き上がって、タオルでふざけて互いをあおぎ、最後は腕を伸ばした距離での汗だくセルフィーと、疲れたハイタッチで締めくくる。

Dialogue:
CHASE: “Okay, it is way too hot in here today.”
PARTNER: “The AC’s been out since this morning, I swear.”
CHASE: “Alright, let’s just push through it.”

CHASE: “Not—me—”
PARTNER: “Okay, that’s officially a tie.”
CHASE: “This heat is actually insane though.”
CHASE, smiling into camera: “Okay, we survived — see you guys!”

雰囲気は、遊び心があり、汗だくで、エネルギッシュ、競争心がありつつ支え合う感じにする。心からの疲労、笑い、荒い呼吸、赤らんだ顔、そして徐々に目立っていく汗をしっかり表現する。

ko.content:
30초 분량, 15컷의 영상을 DV 16mm 테이프 캠코더 감성으로 제작한다. 핸드헬드 POV가 CHASE와 그녀의 운동 파트너 사이를 번갈아 오가며, 가끔은 벤치/랙 위에 올려둔 카메라 시점의 샷도 포함된다. 완벽하지 않은 프레이밍, 손떨림, 늦게 잡히는 초점, 어설픈 줌, 약간의 블러, 테이프 노이즈, 따뜻하게 번지는 하이라이트, 깜빡이는 자동 노출, 낮은 대비, 자연스러운 피부 톤. 캠코더 자체는 절대 보이지 않는다.

캐릭터: CHASE는 20대 한국인 여성으로, 높게 묶은 검은 포니테일, 표정이 풍부한 눈, 상기된 볼, 슬림한 운동 체형을 지녔으며, 단정한 긴팔 운동 상의, 조거 팬츠/레깅스, 스니커즈를 착용한다. 운동하면서 머리카락이 땀으로 눈에 띄게 젖어 간다. PARTNER는 20대 한국인 여성으로, 뒤로 묶은 머리와 비슷한 운동 체형을 지녔으며, 단정한 긴팔 운동복과 스니커즈를 착용한다. 두 사람 모두 첨부된 레퍼런스 이미지를 사용한다.

배경: 에어컨이 고장 난 한여름 저녁의 헬스장. 고정식 선풍기가 뜨거운 바람을 내뿜고, 문은 열어 둔 채 받쳐져 있으며, 조명은 유난히 따뜻하고 강하게 느껴진다. 웨이트 랙, 매트, 거울, 벤치, 물병이 보인다.

액션: 두 사람은 더위를 부채질하며 들어와 농담을 주고받는다. 웨이트 랙에서 운동을 시작해 번갈아 들어 올리고 스팟을 봐 주며 서로를 격려한다. 땀에 젖은 손이 바를 꽉 쥔 클로즈업. 숨을 고르며 이미 흠뻑 젖었다고 웃고, 그다음 매트로 가서 필수 물 마시기 휴식을 갖는다. 함께 물을 마신 뒤 플랭크 대결을 하며 누가 먼저 포기할지 서로 놀린다. 버티는 동안 땀이 매트 위로 뚝뚝 떨어지고, 둘은 힘들어하면서도 웃는다. 결국 두 사람 모두 동시에 매트 위로 쓰러지듯 누워 웃으며 숨을 헐떡인다. 다시 상체를 일으켜 장난스럽게 수건으로 서로를 부채질한 뒤, 팔 길이 셀카와 지친 하이파이브로 마무리한다.

PARTNER: “The AC’s been out since this morning, I swear.”
CHASE: “Alright, let’s just push through it.”
CHASE: “You’ve got it, come on!”
PARTNER: “Okay, I’m already soaked.”
CHASE: “Water break, mandatory.”
PARTNER: “Okay, who’s giving up first?”
CHASE: “Not—me—”
PARTNER: “Okay, that’s officially a tie.”
CHASE: “This heat is actually insane though.”
CHASE, smiling into camera: “Okay, we survived — see you guys!”

장난스럽고, 땀에 젖고, 에너지가 넘치며, 경쟁적이지만 서로를 응원하는 분위기로 유지한다. 진짜로 지친 기색, 웃음, 거친 숨소리, 상기된 얼굴, 그리고 점점 더 뚜렷해지는 땀을 강조한다.

pt.content:
Crie um vídeo de 30 segundos, com 15 cortes, com uma estética de filmadora DV de fita 16mm. A POV handheld alterna entre CHASE e sua parceira de treino, com tomadas ocasionais de uma câmera apoiada em um banco/suporte de pesos. Enquadramento imperfeito, tremor de mão, foco atrasado, zooms desajeitados, leve desfoque, ruído de fita, highlights quentes e estourados, autoexposição piscando, contraste suave, tons de pele realistas. O cabelo dela fica visivelmente úmido de suor. PARTNER é uma mulher coreana na faixa dos 20 anos, com o cabelo preso para trás e um físico atlético semelhante, usando roupas discretas de treino de manga longa e tênis. Setting: Academia em uma noite quente de verão, com o ar-condicionado quebrado. Um ventilador fixo sopra ar quente, uma porta está escorada aberta, e a iluminação parece incomumente quente e dura. Rack de pesos, colchonetes, espelhos, bancos e garrafas de água visíveis.

Bebem juntas, depois competem em uma prancha, provocando uma à outra sobre quem vai desistir primeiro. O suor pinga no colchonete enquanto elas lutam e riem. As duas desabam nos colchonetes ao mesmo tempo, rindo e sem fôlego. Elas se sentam, se abanam de brincadeira com uma toalha, e terminam com uma selfie suada com o braço estendido e um high-five cansado.

zh.content:
创建一个 30 秒、15 个镜头的视频，呈现 DV 16mm 磁带摄像机美学。手持 POV 在 CHASE 和她的健身搭档之间交替切换，偶尔穿插来自放在长凳/器械架上的摄像机视角。构图不完美、手部抖动、对焦延迟、笨拙的变焦、轻微模糊、磁带噪点、温暖泛光高光、闪烁的自动曝光、低饱和对比度、真实肤色。摄像机本身始终不可见。

角色：CHASE 是一位 20 多岁的韩国女性，黑色高马尾，眼神生动，脸颊泛红，身材纤细健美，穿着朴素的长袖运动上衣、慢跑裤/紧身裤和运动鞋。她的头发会明显被汗水打湿。PARTNER 是一位 20 多岁的韩国女性，头发扎起，身材相似，穿着朴素的长袖运动服和运动鞋。两人都使用附带的参考图像。

场景：炎热的夏夜健身房，空调坏了。一个固定风扇吹出热风，门半开着，灯光异常温暖而刺眼。可见器械架、垫子、镜子、长凳和水瓶。

动作：她们一边扇风一边进来，开玩笑说太热了。她们在器械架旁准备好，轮流举重和保护对方，互相鼓励。特写：汗湿的手紧握杠铃。她们喘口气，笑着说自己已经浑身湿透，然后走到垫子区进行强制补水休息。她们一起喝水，然后在平板支撑中较量，互相调侃谁会先放弃。汗水滴落在垫子上，她们一边挣扎一边大笑。两人同时瘫倒在垫子上，笑着、气喘吁吁。她们坐起来，拿毛巾互相开玩笑地扇风，最后以一张手臂长度的汗湿自拍和疲惫的击掌收尾。

对白：
CHASE: “Okay, it is way too hot in here today.”
PARTNER: “The AC’s been out since this morning, I swear.”
CHASE: “Alright, let’s just push through it.”
CHASE: “You’ve got it, come on!”
PARTNER: “Okay, I’m already soaked.”
CHASE: “Water break, mandatory.”
PARTNER: “Okay, who’s giving up first?”
CHASE: “Not—me—”
PARTNER: “Okay, that’s officially a tie.”
CHASE: “This heat is actually insane though.”
CHASE, smiling into camera: “Okay, we survived — see you guys!”

整体氛围要俏皮、汗流浃背、充满活力、带有竞争感但彼此支持，同时呈现真实的疲惫、大笑、沉重的呼吸、泛红的脸，以及随着进程越来越明显的汗水。
